pictures.name: knotted_cord_kept_on_a_peg
pictures.scene: a length of cord tied with careful evenly spaced knots and hung on a wooden peg, the cord lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the plain wall above and behind it dim and rough and bare

pictures.name: warm_hearth_in_a_cold_room
pictures.scene: a low stone hearth with a small fire burning steadily in a bare cold room, the embers and hearthstones lit warm and red at the bottom of the frame, the walls above them deep and dim and unlit

pictures.name: standing_stone_weathered_but_upright
pictures.scene: one tall standing stone pitted and scoured by weather and still perfectly upright on open ground, its base lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the stone and sky above it grey and plain

pictures.name: ancient_paving_still_in_use
pictures.scene: a very old paved way of huge worn slabs still smooth and sound and plainly still walked upon, the nearest slabs lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the way beyond them dim and even and long

pictures.name: hot_wind_over_a_scorched_field
pictures.scene: a hot dry wind driving dust across a field burnt brown and bare, the nearest scorched stubble lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the hazy air and sky above it pale and colourless and harsh

pictures.name: lyre_beside_a_travelling_pack
pictures.scene: a small wooden lyre set down on the ground next to a rolled travelling pack, both lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the camp ground and the evening above them quiet and dim and blue

pictures.name: night_window_with_the_lamp_within
pictures.scene: a small window in a dark stone wall with one lamp burning steadily inside it, the sill and the light lit warm and gold low in the frame, the night wall and sky above them deep and black and still

pictures.name: worn_tool_handle_smooth_with_use
pictures.scene: the wooden handle of an old working tool rubbed smooth and dark by daily use, the handle lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the bench and wall above it dim and plain and quiet

lines.text: Remember Your word to Your servant,
upon which You have given me hope.
This is my comfort in affliction,
that Your promise has given me life.
but I do not turn from Your law.
I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD,
and in them I find comfort.
Rage has taken hold of me
because of the wicked who reject Your law.
Your statutes are songs to me
in the house of my pilgrimage.
In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name,
that I may keep Your law.
